  - TechWire says the gap with AIQ is "partly methodological". AIQ covered teams of all sizes, and smaller teams are markedly less likely to have an evaluation pipeline. ([TechWire](https://techwire.example/research/agent-eval-adoption-2026))

| Dimension | AIQ Report | TechWire |
|---|---|---|
